name: GOV safe: RemovedOwner
description: Safe (v1.3.0 data / v1.4.1+ indexed): RemovedOwner(address) emitted by a contract tagged mf-privileged. Default severity critical. The privChangeGuard Web3 Action decodes the change, classifies the new holder (EOA, EIP-7702, Safe, timelock) and checks for prior notice.
